description: Main window: core IPC plus every app command (ADR-0013 AppManifest, permission set mooring-main). No file dialog, file system, shell, http or opener permission: the SFTP file pickers are opened from Rust (ADR-0010, security review 4 B-4), so no local path crosses the IPC boundary. Remote web content runs in web-* windows with the empty web capability.
